title: Stretching for amateur footballers
tagline: 2–3 sessions a week, a proper warm-up, a stretch the next morning, and strength work as you get older.
subject: Fitness

items.name: 2–3 sessions a week
items.why: An hour to an hour and a half a week in total.

items.name: Mix strength training with mobility as you get older
items.why: At 35, your body is less forgiving.

instruction: Help someone follow this routine week to week. Surface new videos from the creators listed, and keep advice practical. Never give medical advice.
